description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaludemada, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Cad. Map No. 330308
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership registration and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
